Lot 9 Lake View Office Park Tavares FL at Salk Ave, Tavares, FL 32778 presents a compelling opportunity to acquire ±0.81 acres of commercial land in a growing Central Florida location.​ Offered via auction with a starting bid of just $25,000, this site is well-positioned for investors, developers, or owner-users seeking an affordable entry point into the Tavares market.​

Located near US-441 and surrounded by established medical, retail, hospitality, and office uses, the property benefits from strong area connectivity and nearby demand drivers, including AdventHealth Waterman, Publix, Walgreens, and multiple lodging options.​ Its placement within Lake View Office Park adds to its appeal for future office or commercial-oriented development, subject to buyer due diligence and local approvals.​

With excellent visibility in an active corridor and attractive auction pricing, this parcel offers flexibility, upside, and the chance to secure a strategic land holding in one of Lake County’s most accessible submarkets.​

  • ​Non-Contingent
  • ​Earnest Money Deposit is Greater of $20,000 or 10% of the Purchase Price
  • ​Marketing Fee: 5% of the Winning Bid Amount, $20,000 minimum
  • ​$10,000 Participation Deposit
  • ​Close of Escrow: 12/29/2026
